sloka: मातामहस्य यो भ्राता ज्येष्ठो भ्राता सुमालिनः ।माल्यवानिति विख्यातो वृद्धः प्राज्ञो निशाचरः ।। ७.२५.२२ ॥
transliteration: mātāmahasya yo bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhrātā sumālinaḥ ।mālyavāniti vikhyāto vṛddhaḥ prājño niśācaraḥ ।। 7.25.22 ॥

translations.english: Malyavan, the elder brother of Sumali, who is our maternal grandfather's brother, is a renowned, old, and wise Rakshasa.
